reason: B offers a more physically plausible and testable processing–microstructure pathway—cryo-rolling plus partial annealing to create heterogeneous domains, back-stress strengthening, and coherent precipitates—and is better grounded in prior HEA studies. Both proposals inadequately justify changes in Young’s modulus and lack explicit high-temperature mechanical testing, but A additionally fails to explain how spatially uniform severe deformation and aging would generate a gradient microstructure.
